correctness.rationale: Each coordinate return congruence (D^n−1)u+K∈βZ has exactly D^n−1 solutions forming one translated grid, independent of the downstream Borel forcing (no differentiability or torus-compatibility used). Solve z, then y conditional on its whole z orbit, then x conditional on both itineraries, producing the product count with no multiplicity error. Möbius inversion and logarithmic zeta expansion are exact. Fubini integrating x then y then z shows invariant normalized volume. Uniform grid quadrature error ≤β/(2N) in each coordinate, telescoped through triangular conditional grids, proves the W1 bound for ordinary ℓ1 metric. For minimum slope E, r=0 and h=z attain lower order; if instead A or C is minimal, the uncoupled zero-forcing subcase and its corresponding coordinate similarly realizes that rate. Independent finite rational fixed-point congruence grids across 108 cases support, not prove, the unlimited Borel statement.
